votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
  AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
  AND (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT s.sname AS school_name FROM satscores s WHERE s.cname = 'Alameda' AND s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND (CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr) >= 0.25 ORDER BY (CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr) DESC

SELECT s."School" AS school_name,
       CASE 
            WHEN ss."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL AND ss."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL AND ss."AvgScrWrite" IS NOT NULL THEN
                CASE 
                    WHEN (ss."AvgScrRead" + ss."AvgScrMath" + ss."AvgScrWrite") >= 1500 THEN 'Tier 1 - Exemplary'
                    WHEN (ss."AvgScrRead" + ss."AvgScrMath" + ss."AvgScrWrite") >= 1300 THEN 'Tier 2 - Proficient'
                    ELSE 'Tier 3 - Needs Improvement'
                END
            ELSE 'No SAT Data'
       END AS accountability_tier
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE s."Charter" = 1
  AND s."County" = 'Alameda'
ORDER BY accountability_tier, school_name;

SELECT 
    sh.School AS SchoolName,
    sh.District AS DistrictName,
    sh.StatusType AS Status,
    s.AvgScrRead,
    s.AvgScrMath,
    s.AvgScrWrite,
    s.NumTstTakr,
    s.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr >= 0.5 THEN 'High Performance'
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr >= 0.3 THEN 'Medium Performance'
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN 'Low Performance'
        ELSE 'No Data'
    END AS AccountabilityTier
FROM schools sh
INNER JOIN satscores s ON sh.CDSCode = s.cds
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON sh.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE sh.Charter = 1 
AND sh.County = 'Alameda'
ORDER BY sh.School ASC

WITH latest_frpm AS (
    SELECT f.*
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f."Academic Year" = (
        SELECT MAX(f2."Academic Year")
        FROM frpm f2
        WHERE f2."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
    )
)
SELECT
    s."School Name" AS school_name,
    s."District Name" AS district_name,
    lf."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent,

FROM schools s
JOIN latest_frpm lf ON s."CDSCode" = lf."CDSCode"

  AND s."County" = 'Alameda'

SELECT f."School Name"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s."County" = 'Alameda'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 0.75
ORDER BY f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" DESC;

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
  AND f."School Type" LIKE '%High School%'
  AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50
ORDER BY f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" DESC

votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s."School" AS school_name,
                s."District" AS district_name,
                s."AdmEmail1" AS email
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."EILCode" = 'INTMIDJR'
  AND sat."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL
  AND sat."AvgScrMath" >= 700;

SELECT 
    sh.School,
    sc.dname,
    sh.AdmEmail1
FROM schools sh
JOIN satscores sc ON sh.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE (sh.SOCType LIKE '%Middle%' OR sh.SOCType LIKE '%Junior High%' OR sh.EILCode = 'INTMIDJR')
  AND sc.AvgScrMath >= 550
  AND sh.AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    s."School" AS school_name,
    s."District" AS district_name,
    s."AdmEmail1" AS contact_email
FROM
    "schools" s
JOIN
    "frpm" f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
JOIN
    "satscores" sc ON s."CDSCode" = sc."cds"
WHERE
    (f."School Type" LIKE '%Middle%' OR (CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 6 AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 8))
    AND CASE
        WHEN sc."AvgScrMath" >= 700 THEN 'A'
        WHEN sc."AvgScrMath" >= 600 THEN 'B'
        WHEN sc."AvgScrMath" >= 500 THEN 'C'
        WHEN sc."AvgScrMath" >= 400 THEN 'D'
        ELSE 'F'
    END = 'A';

votes.sql:
WITH county_scores AS (
    SELECT sname,
           (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS total_avg
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cname = 'Alameda'
      AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
county_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_avg) AS avg_total
    FROM county_scores
)
SELECT sname
FROM county_scores, county_avg
WHERE total_avg < avg_total;

WITH scores AS (
    SELECT
        f."CDSCode" AS cds,
        s."School" AS school_name,
        (ss."AvgScrRead" + ss."AvgScrMath") AS combined_score,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
    JOIN satscores ss ON ss."cds" = f."CDSCode"
    WHERE ss."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL
      AND ss."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL
),
percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        school_name,
        combined_score,
        frpm_percent,
        ((COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY combined_score) - 1) * 100.0 / (COUNT(*) OVER () - 1)) AS pct
    FROM scores
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    CAST(ROUND(pct) AS INTEGER) || 'th percentile' AS "National Percentile"
FROM percentiles
WHERE frpm_percent >= 70
ORDER BY pct DESC;

SELECT 
    s.sname,
    ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite)) * 100) AS national_percentile
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f."CDSCode" = s.cds
WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 0.70
    AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
    AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
    AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL;

WITH sat AS (
    SELECT
        s."CDSCode",
        sch."School" AS school_name,
        (COALESCE(s."AvgScrRead",0) + COALESCE(s."AvgScrMath",0) + COALESCE(s."AvgScrWrite",0)) AS combined_score
    FROM "satscores" s
    JOIN "schools" sch ON s."cds" = sch."CDSCode"
    WHERE s."AvgScrRead" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL
      AND s."AvgScrWrite" IS NOT NULL
),
frpm_filter AS (
    SELECT
        f."CDSCode",
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct
    FROM "frpm" f
    WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 70
)
SELECT
    sat.school_name,
    ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.combined_score) * 100) AS sat_percentile
FROM sat
JOIN frpm_filter ON sat."CDSCode" = frpm_filter."CDSCode"
ORDER BY sat_percentile DESC;

WITH school_poverty AS (
    SELECT 
        f."District Name" AS district,
        CASE

FROM school_poverty

ORDER BY high_poverty_concentration DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH scores AS (
    SELECT
        s."School" AS school_name,
        s."County" AS county,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
        ss."AvgScrMath" AS avg_math,
        (f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * (1600 - ss."AvgScrMath")) AS need_score
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
    LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON f."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
    WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND ss."AvgScrMath" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT school_name, county, frpm_pct, avg_math, need_score
FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY need_score DESC) AS rn
    FROM scores
) sub
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY county, need_score DESC;
